sn12.15:1.2: atha kho āyasmā kaccānagotto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā kaccānagotto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.15:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante sammādiṭṭhi hotīti?
sn12.15:2.1: dvayaṃnissito kho’yaṃ kaccāna loko yebhuyyena atthitañceva natthitañca.
sn12.15:2.2: lokasamudayañca kho kaccāna yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke natthitā, sā na hoti.
sn12.15:2.3: lokanirodhaṃ kho kaccāna yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke atthitā, sā na hoti.
sn12.15:2.5: tañca upāyupādānaṃ cetaso adhiṭṭhānaṃ abhinivesānusayaṃ na upeti, na upādiyati, nādhiṭṭhāti ‘attā me’ti.
sn12.15:2.6: dukkhameva uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, dukkhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ nirujjhatīti na kaṅkhati. na vicikicchati. aparappaccayā ñāṇamevassa ettha hoti.
sn12.15:3.3: ete te kaccāna ubho ante anupagamma majjhena tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti.
